title: Get 40-70% Off Gym Memberships in Dunedin – Exercise NZ Guide
meta_desc: Learn how Dunedin residents can slash 40‑70% off gym fees with Exercise NZ’s subsidised scheme. Step‑by‑step guide, eligible gyms and savings explained.
intro: Exercise NZ offers a government‑backed discount on gym memberships for eligible New Zealanders. In Dunedin you can tap into this scheme and pay a fraction of the standard price.

sections.heading: What is the Exercise NZ subsidised gym scheme?
sections.body: The Exercise NZ programme is a national initiative that subsidises gym memberships for qualifying New Zealanders. It is delivered through a partnership between the Ministry of Health, local gyms and community organisations. The aim is to make regular exercise affordable and increase national physical activity levels. For full details visit https://exercise.org.nz, the official portal where you can check eligibility and apply online.

sections.heading: Who is eligible?
sections.body: The discount is open to a wide range of residents who meet one or more of the following criteria:
list: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents
Low‑to‑moderate income earners (based on IRD tax code)
People with a disability that limits mobility

sections.heading: How to claim your discount – step by step
sections.body: Claiming the Exercise NZ discount is straightforward. Follow these steps and you’ll be ready to start training at a reduced rate:
list: 1. Register on the Exercise NZ portal (https://exercise.org.nz) and create a personal account.
2. Verify your eligibility by uploading the required documents – e.g., IRD notice of assessment, student ID, benefit statement or pension card.
3. Choose a participating gym from the list provided on the portal.
4. The system will generate a unique discount code linked to your account.
5. Take the code to the gym’s reception or email it to their membership team. They will apply the discount to your contract.
6. Sign the membership agreement – note that most gyms still require a minimum 12‑month contract unless you opt for a no‑contract provider.

sections.heading: How much could you save?
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy covers between 40 % and 70 % of the standard membership fee, depending on your eligibility category and the gym’s pricing structure. For example, a $85 Les Mills membership could drop to as low as $34 per month – a $51 saving each month, or $612 per year. Even the no‑contract Anytime Fitness option can be reduced from $70 to $28, saving $42 monthly. These savings make regular training accessible for students, retirees and anyone on a tight budget.
list: Typical savings range: $20‑$55 per month per gym
Annual savings can exceed $600 for higher‑priced clubs
Discounts are applied directly to the contract price – no extra vouchers needed
